Corollary
[Conformal Flatness Forces Vanishing Weyl Tensor] ↗ thm:conformal-transformation-curvature 1. ch7:7.31

If a Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold of dimension $n\geq 3$ is locally conformally flat, then its Weyl tensor vanishes identically.

Proof

\sketch Locally, a conformal multiple $\widetilde g=e^{2f}g$ is flat and therefore has $\widetilde W=0$. Formula (7.48) implies $W=0$.

□

For $n\geq 3$, define the Cotton tensor by $C=-DP$; in a local frame, \begin{equation} C_{ijk}=P_{ij;k}-P_{ik;j}. \tag {7.49} \end{equation}
